title: RequestOrigin
description: The originating user/API submission a job came from. This is the SOURCE OF MUTATION IDENTITY: a job's idempotency identity is derived from (project_id, request_id, operation_index), never from the operation contents. Two intentional submissions of the same instruction carry different request_ids and therefore both execute; a retry of one submission reuses its request_id and therefore executes once. operation_index distinguishes multiple operations produced by a single request.

request_id.description: Stable identifier of the originating submission. Assigned once by the client (or by the API when it first accepts the submission) and reused verbatim on retries.

operation_index.description: Zero-based position of this operation within the originating request. A request that yields one job uses 0.
